description: This file implements a PasswordHasher class using PBKDF2 with per-user salt for password hashing and verification.

classes.name: PasswordHasher
classes.description: A PBKDF2 password hasher with per-user salt implementing IPasswordHasher interface.

methods.name: HashPassword
methods.description: Generates a salted hash for a given password, returning both hash and salt.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies if a password matches the provided hash and salt.

methods.name: PBKDF2
methods.description: Private static method that derives a key from a password and salt using PBKDF2 with SHA256.
